meta.title: KPI-Gated Officer Knowledge Evolution Lifecycle
meta.subtitle: Candidate practices become active officer expertise ONLY when proven to increase the officer's main KPI

states.label: Proposed
states.explanation: A human or AI submits a candidate KnowledgePractice + VerificationSample[] proof for Engineering, Security, or Bridge Officer.

states.label: Safety Gate
states.explanation: Validates KnowledgeUpdateProposalSchema and verifies every regex in practice.matcher passes validateRegexSafety (no nested quantifiers or backreferences).

states.label: KPI Proof
states.explanation: Runs counterfactual virtual-file replay across compliant and violating samples (or opt-in CLI benchmark) requiring strict KPI delta > 0 and 0 false positives.

states.label: Promoted
states.explanation: Appends officer.knowledge.updated, increments officer knowledgeVersion, and activates the practice in deterministic replay.

states.label: Live
states.explanation: Practice runs in every officer assessment and Party Mode session while kpiHistory is continuously monitored.

states.label: Rejected
states.explanation: Proposal rejected due to unsafe regex, false positives, unpermitted MCP benchmark exec, or non-positive KPI delta (delta <= 0).

states.label: Regressed
states.explanation: auditLiveRegressions detects a live KPI score drop exceeding threshold across recent kpiHistory measurements.

states.label: Reverted
states.explanation: revertPractice deactivates the regressed practice (active = false) while preserving full cryptographic history.

cards.title: Zero Hallucinated Self-Updates
items: Officers cannot self-modify based on unverified opinions or prompt instructions
Every promoted check must prove discrimination between compliant and violating samples

cards.title: Reversible by Construction
items: Every evolution step is an immutable stream event
n1 evolve audit and n1 evolve revert roll back broken rules cleanly
